title: Near Optimal Finite Model POMDP Approximation of Controlled Diffusion with Partial Information
summary: We study continuous-time stochastic control problems under partial information. Our main contributions are the following: (i) We show near optimality, under finite horizon as well as discounted infinite horizon cost criteria, of piece-wise constant control policies obtained via solutions to discrete-time partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP) approximations, constructed via Euler-Maruyama approximations of both state and observation processes; (ii) we obtain several regularity properties of such POMDP approximate models; and (iii) using these regularity properties, we arrive at…
